title: Bullish Engulfing Follow-Through
summary: Of the sessions whose green body engulfed the prior red session's body: a session-level bullish engulfing candle: how often the NEXT session closed green. The denominator is engulfing sessions with a next session on record; the numerator is the ones followed by a green close. Session-level engulfings are much rarer than intraday ones: expect small N, and let the guards, not the point estimate, set the tone when the sample is thin.
deltas: an explicit engulfing definition (body engulfs prior red body) instead of chart-by-chart judgment
minimum-N guards and CIs keep rare-pattern statistics honest
next-session return distribution attached alongside the rate
